tasks.label: BloodLink: create venv and install requirements (first time)

windows.command: python -m venv venv; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt

linux.command: python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

osx.command: python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
